signin_desc: Sign in to keep your family in sync.
verify_email_desc: Please verify your email address by clicking on the link we just emailed to you.
verification_sent: A new verification link has been sent to the email address you provided during registration.
try_demo_hint: No account needed. A sample family you can change freely; it resets every night.
social_failed: Signing in didn't complete. Please try again.
social_no_email: That account didn't share an email address with us, so we can't sign you in with it. Please use your email instead.
social_unverified: That account's email address isn't verified yet, so we can't use it to sign you in. Please use your email instead.
legal_agree: By continuing, you agree to our :terms and :privacy.
register_desc: Just your email. We'll send you a code, no password needed.
code_wrong: That code isn't right or has expired. Check the latest email, or send a new code.
code_too_many: Too many codes for this address. Wait a few minutes and try again.
code_email_preview: Your code is :code. It works for 10 minutes.
code_email_intro: Type this code in FamilyWell to continue. No password needed.
code_email_expires: It works for 10 minutes and only once.
code_email_ignore: Didn't ask for this? You can ignore this email, nobody can get in without the code.
code_email_tagline: One calm app for your family
password_wrong: That email and password don't match.
